repayment_method: Not applicable; Smart Crypto Lending is currently presented as an active service and the reviewed first-party sources do not establish a platform-wide failure, claims process, restructuring or customer-loss event.
notes: The contractual promise to return principal plus interest after the lending term is a product term, not evidence of universal realized repayment. CYA found no first-party evidence in this review of a platform-wide adverse customer outcome, and does not infer solvency or repayment performance from the continued availability of the service.
